items.title: A major Alzheimer’s risk gene may shrink brain cells years before symptoms
items.summary: Researchers have uncovered a possible reason why the Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 can disrupt the brain long before memory problems begin. items.title: A hidden “on switch” in human DNA has finally been decoded
items.summary: Researchers have used AI to uncover the DNA signature of a key genetic “switch” involved in turning genes on. items.title: El Niño set to be 'strongest in living memory', says Met Office
items.summary: Scientists say the growing El Niño weather pattern is an "unprecedented event" and means 2027 is likely to be the world's hottest year on record.

items.title: Physicists create a tiny “Big Bang” with surprisingly small atomic nuclei
items.summary: Researchers at CERN have created microscopic versions of the early Universe by colliding surprisingly small atomic nuclei at nearly the speed of light. items.title: JWST finds early galaxies may be 4 times more massive than thought
items.summary: Astronomers using JWST have discovered that massive early galaxies contain far more small, faint stars than expected.
